C1525.title: Hacker Phished for $48 Million via Malicious Approval Contract Attack
C1525.summary: Public on-chain security analysis shows that a hacker previously involved in the UXLINK incident later fell victim to phishing and signed a malicious smart-contract approval transaction, leading to the transfer of roughly USD 48 million in digital assets from the wallet. The incident illustrates the risk of ERC-20 approval abuse: once a user grants a malicious contract a high or unlimited allowance, the attacker can later move assets through transfer functions.
